[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]It cannot remain free. For the sake of my people,[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It's just... I...I want...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

me to believe this rubbish?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT15 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Believe what you want, lady.[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]That'll be me then.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]In any case, the only reason we got[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]you're all right in my book.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You've got my vote. A lady should not go[XENO:n ]
